basic_info.description: The spirit of North Beach abounds in this classic 2-Level San Francisco Waterfront residence.  The floor plan features a great room located in the front of the building and it is flooded with natural light.   In addition on this level, you have a large guest bedroom and superb chef's kitchen and walk-out sundrenched patio.   Downstairs is the grand primary suite and a 2nd family room/ lounge AND a romantic outdoor cafe' patio for indoor/ outdoor enjoyment.  You cannot help but feel like you are in Europe.  It is what makes this place so cool.  The San Francisco comeback story has always been about the bold and those who have a passion for the historic.  2147 Mason is all that while showcasing modern upgrades. As an investment, you will love the flexibility of this floor plan to be either 2 or 3 bedrooms. If you are a couple or partners, you will love the two separate floors when working from home.  Space is nice!   And if you are an outdoor enthusiast, you will find yourself at the epicenter of fun and sun in North Beach and along the waterfront.
